h1: How tall can a house be in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Building Height Limits for Houses
description: Newton's maximum house heights: 36 feet sloped roof, 30 feet flat roof, 2.5 stories (3 by special permit), and how height is measured.
short_answer: In Newton's SR and MR districts, a detached single- or two-family house may be up to 36 feet tall with a sloped roof or 30 feet with a flat roof. The limit is 2.5 stories, or 3 by special permit (Ord. Sec. 3.1.3 and 3.2.3).

facts.text: SR1–SR3 detached single-family: 36' sloped roof, 30' flat roof (Sec. 3.1.3).
SR1–SR3: 2.5 stories, or 3 stories by special permit.
MR1–MR4 detached single- or two-family: 36' sloped, 30' flat, 2.5 stories or 3 by special permit (Sec. 3.2.3).
Height is measured vertically from the average grade plane to the highest point of the roof, subject to listed exclusions (Sec. 1.5.4.A.1).

qa.q: What is the height limit for a house in Newton?
qa.a: 36 feet with a sloped roof and 30 feet with a flat roof in SR and MR districts.

qa.q: How many stories can I build?

qa.a: From the average grade plane to the highest roof point, subject to exclusions listed in Sec. 1.5.4.
